# npnp v3.1.0

## 新增

- `npnp merge` 支持离线合并现有 Altium 和 KiCad 库。
- 支持 `.SchLib`、`.PcbLib`、`.kicad_sym`、`.pretty` 和 `.3dshapes`。
- `--force` 可覆盖已有输出；更换输出名时，无需删除之前的合并库。

```bash
npnp merge -i path/to/libraries -o merged/MyParts
npnp merge -i path/to/libraries -o merged/MyParts --force
```

Altium 和 KiCad 库请放在不同目录中。

---

# npnp v3.1.0 (English)

## Added

- `npnp merge` now merges existing Altium and KiCad libraries offline.
- Supports `.SchLib`, `.PcbLib`, `.kicad_sym`, `.pretty`, and `.3dshapes` inputs.
- Use `--force` to replace existing outputs. Previous merged libraries can stay in the input directory when choosing a new output name.

```bash
npnp merge -i path/to/libraries -o merged/MyParts
npnp merge -i path/to/libraries -o merged/MyParts --force
```

Keep Altium and KiCad libraries in separate input directories.
